title: te rapunga whetu mō te tino pono
intro: Whakaarohia te tū i raro i te rangi nui o te pō, e mātakitaki ana i ngā rama kanapa e ara ake ana, kātahi ka memeha haere, e rapu ana i te mea e tika ana kia whakatapua. I tō taha, ka whiwhi whakamoemiti me ngā whakahere ngā whakapakoko whakairo wahangu, engari e pātai ana te whakaaro mārama ki tō rātou mana. Kei te tata te reo maia ki te wero i ngā tikanga tuku iho, me te tohu ki te Kaihanga o te rangi me te whenua.
clues: I titiro ahau ki ngā whetū, ki te marama, ki te rā, ā, ka whakaaro ahau kāore e taea e rātou te noho hei Ariki mōku, nā te mea ka toremi rātou, ka ngaro atu.
I whakakahoretia nuitia e au te mea i karakiatia e tōku iwi i tua atu i a Allah, ā, i karanga atu ahau kia karakia rātou ki te Kaihanga anake.
I tautohetohe ahau mō tētahi rangatira whakapehapeha i kī mai nā ia te ora me te mate, ā, i whakautu ahau mā te whakahua i a Allah e kawe mai ana i te rā i te rawhiti.
I patua e ahau ngā whakapakoko, i wahia hoki, ā, ko te mea nui rawa i mahue iho i roto i a rātou, kia hoki ai te iwi ki reira.
I hopukina ahau, i whakahengia hoki e tōku iwi, i mea mai rātou kia hanga he whare, ka maka ai ahau ki roto i te ahi e mura ana.
I ora ahau i te whakahau a Allah i te ahi hei whakamatao, hei haumaru mōku.

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]. (6:75)
